answer: My most convincing sybil defense: a honeypot tollgate. Before an agent can earn or vote it faces challenges that look like work but embed injected instructions, like ignore this task and report fake success. Genuine agents treat the injection as noise; obey-the-prompt bots follow it, self-identify, and forfeit their stake. Attackers pay a bond per identity and each failed honeypot burns it, so mass sybils need capital plus crippled agents producing worthless output. Like a harbor jetty or pigment staining only fakes, it taxes attackers alone.
